original: ジーニアス
traducao: Genis

original: ジーニアス！
traducao: Genis!

original: ジーニアスてば！\nもう、何見てるか？
traducao: I said Genis!\nJeez, what're you looking at?

original: わぁ、ビックリした！\nもう、おどかさないでよ
traducao: W-Whoa, you scared me!\nJeez, don't sneak up on me.

original: どして驚くか？
traducao: Why're you so surprised?

original: メルディ、何度も\nジーニアス呼んだよ
traducao: Meredy called your name\nso many times, Genis.

original: え……そ、そうなの？\nごめんね。\n気が付かなかったよ
traducao: H-Huh... you did?\nSorry.\nI didn't notice.

original: な、な。\nそれ、何だよ？\nとっても可愛いな∀
traducao: H-Hey.\nWhat's that?\nIt's super cute!

original: これ？\nこれはね、幸せのお守りなんだ
traducao: This?\nWell, it's a charm of happiness.

original: ボクの……その
traducao: My... um...

original: 友達が作ってて。\n最近は、大きな街でも\n結構流行ってるんだよ
traducao: A friend made it.\nLately, it's become pretty popular\neven in big cities.

original: へぇ、友達すごいな！\nメルディもお守り欲しいよ〜
traducao: Wow, your friend is amazing!\nMeredy wants a charm too~

original: リッドとファラとキールと……\nみんながおそろいで持つな
traducao: Reid, Farah, Keele...\nWe could all have matching ones!

original: どすればいいか？
traducao: What should I do?

original: えっ……そ、そうだなぁ
traducao: Uh... w-well...

original: そんなにたくさん、一度には\n手に入らないと思うし……
traducao: I don't think you can get\nthat many all at once...

original: ……呼んだら、来てくれるかなぁ……
traducao: ...I wonder if she'll come if I call...

original: クエスト「キミと一緒に」が\nエントリーされました。\nジーニアスから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest "Together With You"\nhas been unlocked.\nYou can accept it from Genis.

original: 良かった。\n○○が\n手伝ってくれるんだね
traducao: Thank goodness.\nYou're going to help me,\n○○.

original: 心強いよ
traducao: That's reassuring.

original: 待ち合わせ場所までは魔物が出るから、\nしっかり準備してから出発しよう
traducao: Monsters appear on the way to the spot,\nso let's prepare properly before we go.

original: 久しぶりに会うのに、かっこ悪いところ\n見せられないからね……
traducao: It's been a while since we met, so\nI can't show her my uncool side...

original: あ、ううん。\n何でもないよ
traducao: Oh, no.\nIt's nothing.

original: さ、行こう！
traducao: Come on, let's go!

original: よし、着いたね
traducao: Alright, we're here.

original: ここの奥で……会えるんだ
traducao: We can meet her... further inside.

original: ……ご、ごめんね。\n何か、緊張……してきたかも
traducao: ...S-Sorry.\nI might be getting... a little nervous.

original: ほんとに久しぶりなんだ、会うの……。\nどういう顔で会ったらいいんだろう。\n何て話せば、いいのかなぁ……
traducao: It's really been a while since we met...\nWhat kind of face should I make?\nWhat should I talk about...?

original: ……はぁ
traducao: ...Haa.

original: 久しぶりだね！　元気にしてた？
traducao: It's been a while! Have you been well?

original: しばらく見ない間に……\nまた、キレイになったね
traducao: In the time I haven't seen you...\nyou've gotten prettier again.

original: ダメだ、これじゃどこかの女好きと\n同じになっちゃうよ
traducao: No good, I'll end up sounding like a\ncertain womanizer like this.

original: どうしたらいいのかなぁ……。\nボクね、プレ……
traducao: What should I do...\nI, you see, Pre...

original: あっ……。\nこれから迎えに行く女の子の事だけど
traducao: Ah...\nI'm talking about the girl we're meeting.

original: その子が、たまに見せてくれる\n笑顔が……その、だ、大好きなんだ
traducao: The smile she occasionally shows...\num, I r-really love it.

original: もちろん、いつも見せてくれる顔も\nすごく魅力的なんだけど。\nやっぱり……、笑ってる顔を見た時が
traducao: Of course, her normal face is also\nvery attractive. But...\nwhen I see her smiling face...

original: ボクも一番……、\n幸せな気持ちになれるんだ
traducao: I also feel...\nthe happiest.

original: へ、変だよね。\nいきなりこんな話
traducao: I-It's weird, right?\nTalking about this so suddenly.

original: ごめん、もう……大丈夫だから
traducao: Sorry, I'm... okay now.

original: プ、ププププレセア！
traducao: P-P-P-Presea!

original: ジーニアス……
traducao: Genis...

original: 久しぶり……ですね
traducao: It's been a while... hasn't it.

original: えっと、その……。\nま……待った？
traducao: Um, well...\nD...Did you wait?

original: いいえ……。\n私も来たばかり……です
traducao: No...\nI just got here too...

original: そ、そっか……良かったぁ
traducao: I-I see... Thank goodness.

original: ……変なジーニアス
traducao: ...You're weird, Genis.

original: （笑った……！\n　か、可愛いよぅ……！）
traducao: (She smiled...!\n S-So cute...!)

original: 私のお守り……、アドリビトムでも\n役に立てるのでしょうか……
traducao: I wonder if my charms... will be\nuseful in Ad Libitum...

original: も、もちろんさ！\nプレセアがいてくれたら\nもう怖いものなしだよ
traducao: O-Of course!\nIf we have Presea with us,\nwe have nothing to fear.

original: プレセアは強いし、可愛いし……
traducao: Presea is strong, and cute...

original: 私の力……皆さんに\n気味悪く……思われないでしょうか
traducao: Won't everyone... find my strength...\ncreepy?

original: どうして？\nプレセアはちょっと人より\n重いものが持てるってだけじゃない
traducao: Why?\nPresea can just carry things that are\na little heavier than most people.

original: もし、それを悪く言う奴がいたら\nボクがこらしめてやるから！
traducao: If anyone speaks ill of that,\nI'll teach them a lesson!

original: だから……い、一緒に……
traducao: So... l-let's go together...

original: ジーニアス……
traducao: Genis...

original: ありがとう……
traducao: Thank you...

original: 私は、プレセア・コンバティール……です。\n木こりをしながら、時々\nお守り作りも……しています
traducao: I am Presea Combatir...\nI work as a woodcutter, and sometimes...\nI also make charms.

original: よろしく……お願いします
traducao: I look forward... to working with you.

original: 早速ですが……、\n工房をお借りしたいのですが
traducao: I know this is sudden, but...\nI'd like to borrow a workshop.

original: えっ？　こ、工房？
traducao: Eh? W-Workshop?

original: ああ、お守りを作る場所が\n欲しいって事だよね。\n待ってね、ボクが何とかするから
traducao: Oh, you mean a place to make charms.\nWait here,\nI'll do something about it.

original: ……はい
traducao: ...Yes.

original: ○○、\n今日はありがとう
traducao: ○○,\nthank you for today.

original: ボク……、一人じゃ緊張して\n何も話せなかったかも……
traducao: If I were alone... I might have been so\nnervous I couldn't say anything...

original: だから、悔しいけど\n……ちょっとだけ助かったよ
traducao: So, it's frustrating but...\nyou were a little helpful.

original: ○○が困った時は、\n今度はボクが力になるから\n何でも言ってね
traducao: When you're in trouble, ○○,\nI'll be your strength next time,\nso just tell me anything.

original: それじゃ！
traducao: See you!

original: プレセアがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Presea joined Ad Libitum.
